public_payload.normalized_proposition: In 2029, AI will not be able to read a novel and reliably answer questions about plot, character, conflicts, motivations, etc., where the key is going beyond the literal text.
conditions: key will be going beyond the literal text

statement.excerpt: In 2029, AI will not be able to read a novel and reliably answer questions about plot, character, conflicts, motivations, etc.
statement.document_title: Dear Elon Musk, here are five things you might want to consider about AGI

from_speaker: reliably answer questions about plot, character, conflicts, motivations, etc.
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is dependable comprehension of whole novels, including reasonable inferences about motives, relationships and conflicts.
Going beyond the literal text defines the task. It is not an external antecedent whose occurrence must be established separately.
Test varied novels and questions with controls for memorized summaries. Reliability does not require agreement on every debatable literary interpretation.
Use 2029-12-31 as the latest deadline, allowing an earlier reproducible demonstration of the complete capability to refute the forecast.
Assess this individual forecast independently of the surrounding multi-challenge wager.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the end of 2029 shows that leading available systems still fail to answer questions dependably about whole novels, including questions requiring inference about plot, characters, conflicts and motivations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one AI system reliably answers questions across varied whole novels, including nonliteral questions, under a credible evaluation with human-validated answers.

evidence.explanation: PRELUDE tests whether proposed character backstories fit a novel, requiring indirect evidence and inference. Its reported human-model gaps concern a demanding related task and do not settle the broader 2029 forecast.

This study evaluates a fixed local model on detective-novel questions and reports limited performance. It neither establishes general reliable comprehension nor measures the strongest available systems.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verify strong existing results against the whole-novel, nonliteral-comprehension criteria, including independent replication. A qualifying result would contradict the forecast early; otherwise assess dependable performance across varied novels through the end of 2029.
